components.name: forms
components.recipe:
FROM docker.io/library/node:22-bookworm-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
RUN npm run build
FROM docker.io/library/caddy:2-alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist/ /srv/public/
COPY --from=build /app/.luxisoft-runtime/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
EXPOSE 8080

components.name: forms-api
components.recipe:
FROM docker.io/library/node:22-bookworm-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
RUN npm run build
ENV PORT=8080 HOST=0.0.0.0 NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["sh","-lc","node api-server.mjs"]
